rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a thing's functions or the tasks it is equipped to perform.

example.english: This app has plenty of functionality and can even scan documents.
example.traditional: 呢個手機程式功能齊全，連掃描文件都得。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 sau2 gei1 cing4 sik1 gung1 nang4 cai4 cyun4 lin4 sou3 miu4 man4 gin6 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this specifically when focusing on whether something is capable of operating or carrying out a task.

example.english: We will not know whether the old computer still has the functionality to operate until we turn it on.
example.traditional: 部舊電腦仲有冇運作能力，要開機試過先知。
example.jyutping: bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 zung6 jau5 mou5 wan6 zok3 nang4 lik6 jiu3 hoi1 gei1 si3 gwo3 sin1 zi1
